scope:
Compare supplied completed pulse recipes at separate H/CNO return fractions.

Stage-map JSON maps four recipe keys to a path or {record,initial_Y,
initial_counts,trace_path}. Paths are relative to --root unless absolute.
This tool never infers input stoichiometry from a label or filename.
normalization: One NET helium4 nucleus, actual atomic input/output masses; physical preparation/capture efficiencies remain explicit requirements.

processing.decay_inventory_scope: Multiply by He/s for all-flight-plus-catcher parent inventory at steady production; no additional reactions or selective loss. Post-wall allocation needs each new arrival history.

result.interpretation: Maximum allowed eventual unrecoverable-loss boundary; available carbon budget need not be consumed; not predicted or required apparatus loss.
